title: Object Schema (ABSTRACT base)
description: Layer 0 of the canonical ontology (DECISION-ONTOLOGY-CANONICAL-KERNEL-001): `object` describes ANYTHING and is the abstract base every concrete kind inherits - the envelope only (id, type=kind, subkind?, status, provenance, content-sha). It is NEVER stored bare; store a concrete flavor instead (principal, policy, object-ref, relationship, act, assertion, authority, capability). `thing` and `state` are derived projections, not stored kinds. Enforced by lore_validate.py Check 4 (a bare `type: object` is rejected).

type.description: the concrete kind (never the literal 'object', which is abstract).

subkind.description: optional refinement of the kind (e.g. alias, event, evidence, evaluation, context-hint).
